title: Failure of Interior Hölder and Gradient Estimates for the Subcritical Special Lagrangian Equation
summary: For every $n\ge3$, we show, by a family of explicit entire real-analytic solutions, that, for every subcritical phase and every $0<α\le1$, oscillation-based interior $C^α$ estimates fail for the special Lagrangian equation in $\mathbb{R}^n$. In fact, this family has no common interior modulus of continuity.
